Thanks — quick technical confirmation and proposal: 

1) Event schema (we will include these fields for each record): timestamp (ISO8601), tenant_id, actor (internal user id + display name), actor_role, action_type, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, session_id (when applicable), client_ip (v4/v6), region, outcome (success/fail), change_summary (JSON blob for before/after), and trace_id for cross-service correlation.

2) Retention & PII: default retention is 12 months for admin activity. We do not log full request payloads or model input tokens in admin records. Fields that may contain identifiers: actor display names, resource_id; we can provide a pseudonymized export (hashed resource ids) on request. For SIG/CAIQ we usually deliver a PII-minimized package unless the auditor requests identity-level evidence.

3) Export options (choose one we will implement for delivery):
   - Full snapshot (single time-bounded bundle): JSONL files partitioned by month + an HMAC-signed manifest (SHA256) for each file. Delivery via presigned S3 links; checksum included in manifest.
   - Incremental deltas: daily gzipped Parquet shards with incremental sequence numbers + signed manifest. Good for streaming ingestion into customer SIEM.
   - Aggregated summary CSV: event counts by type, top actors, and pivot tables for quick review.

4) Proof & attestation: we can produce an attested manifest file signed with Redwood's export key (HMAC + timestamp) and include file-level SHA256s. If required, we can timestamp the manifest with an attestation from our compliance team.

5) Delivery ETA & ops: for the 12-month full snapshot I estimate 3 business days to prepare, run a redaction/pseudonymization pass, and stage presigned links. If you want incremental deltas instead, we can provide an initial 30-day sample in 24 hours.

6) Exceptions & scope notes: ephemeral caches (KV cache contents) and transient inference payloads are not part of admin events. We do include model deployment events, rollout notes, and operator-initiated rollback logs.

I will attach the export_spec_v3.1.pdf that details field mapping and sample manifests.

-Karthik
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
(attachment: export_specs_v3.1.pdf)
